name: Utvara
description: A harsh barony outside the main city of Ravnica, ruled by Teysa Karlov, with an Orzhov-owned settlement and Gruul-controlled wilderness.

description_citations.text: "Utvara Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Construction in the Utvara district awakens five nephilim, who feed on a dragon corpse and grow in size and power.
timeline.quote: five of the creatures fed on a dragon corpse and grew in size and power

citation.text: "Nephilim", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izzet goblin Kaluzax is shot down by Gruul while flying an observosphere to bomb Utvara.
timeline.quote: Kaluzax is attacked by Gruul however and goes down with the ship.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle makes Teysa baroness of Utvara and they travel there by lokopede with Melisk and Crix.
timeline.quote: makes his cousin Teysa Karlov the baroness of Utvara

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle reveals he had Hauc drop the mana bomb; it goes awry, creating the Schism and mutating the plague.
timeline.quote: the explosion creates a weird wrinkle in the sky called the Schism and causes the plague to mutate.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aun Yom is killed and rises again; his band attacks the lokopede and Uncle is killed.
timeline.quote: Aun Yom and his band of thugs, or whoever is in their bodies now, attack the lokopede.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa and Melisk bring Uncle's corpse into Pivlic's bar where Kos works.
timeline.quote: carrying the corpse of Uncle, who was killed during the Gruul attack.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa hires Aradoz and charges Dr. Nebun with curing the Kuga plague.
timeline.quote: She charges him with making a cure for the Kuga plague

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle becomes a ghost, joins the Obzedat and watches Teysa through a mirror.
timeline.quote: He now is a ghost and has joined the Obzedat

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos studies the Schism and sees the Kuga mot while searching for Feather and Parhelion.
timeline.quote: The Kuga Mot appears, a mysterious glowing sphere or apparition

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trijiro orders Crix released to improve Gruul relations with other guilds.
timeline.quote: orders the release of Crix

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa sends Pivlic, Kos and the Grugg Brothers to rescue Crix; Nebun reveals he always had a cure and Teysa buys it.
timeline.quote: Nebun reveals that he had a cure for the Kuga all along.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crix and Kos's parties flee Aun Yom's party and realize they are zombies.
timeline.quote: figure out that they are actually zombies along the way.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa discovers Melisk has been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes; she breaks her oath.
timeline.quote: Teysa's memory is returned.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa rallies Utvara against the Cauldron and takes control of the Taj, who murder Melisk.
timeline.quote: They murder Melisk and join Teysa's army.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a dogfight Hauc dies; the two dragons kill each other.
timeline.quote: The two dragons kill each other

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos is impaled in the crash, sees Feather emerge from the kuga mot, and dies.
timeline.quote: and Agrus Kos passes away.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Kos's funeral Hauc's spirit awakens, hearing voices of other spirits.
timeline.quote: Hauc's spirit awakens and hears the voices of other spirits calling him.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crixizix watches the five Nephilim grow gigantic and calls on Niv-Mizzet through the Firemind.
timeline.quote: She uses the Firemind to contact Niv-Mizzet .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet defeats two Nephilim, then retreats; Crixizix abandons hope in her guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet arrives in Utvara and defeats two of the Nephilim (Witch-Maw and Dune-Brood), before taking minor damage.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Capobar retrieves cerebral fluid in Utvara and finds the nephilim feeding on the dragon and growing titanic.
timeline.quote: had been feeding upon the dragon, and were steadily growing to titanic size.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sabast leads Domri deep into the Utvara and explains the Gruul view of death and nature.
timeline.quote: Look how nature responds,

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sabast leads Domri through a hidden cave to a grave and declares it time for the false Domri to die and the real one to be born.
timeline.quote: It is time for the false you to die.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Buried alive in the Gruul rite of passage at Utvara, Domri panics and his eyes are opened.
timeline.quote: It was then, in the darkness, that his eyes were opened.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Rite of Passage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Burying at Utvara, Domri's spark ignites and sends him to Alara; on return, Sabast declares he passed.
timeline.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Utvara is devastated by a Simic-origin plague worsened by Gruul encroachment and is declared a reclamation zone.
timeline.quote: Utvara was devastated by a Simic -origin plague.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaluzax deploys a prototype bomb on Hauc's orders; instead of exploding it forms the Schism, draining life and trapping spirits.
timeline.quote: Instead of exploding, the device formed a warped rift in the sky

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A scavenger uncovers a buried city, sparking illegal prospecting financed by the Orzhov and an unlawful shantytown.
timeline.quote: a scavenger uncovered a vast buried city beneath the brickwork

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Izzet return after discovering three unhatched dragon eggs and build the Cauldron.
timeline.quote: the Izzet established the Cauldron , a massive steamworks complex built into the Utvara Flats

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle orchestrates his own death through Melisk, who manipulates Teysa into unknowingly assassinating him; Teysa later uncovers the truth.
timeline.quote: Uncle" orchestrated his death to ascend to the Ghost Council

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa rallies local guild elements to halt Hauc's apocalyptic ambitions.
timeline.quote: Teysa uncovered the truth and rallied local guild elements to halt Hauc’s apocalyptic ambitions.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Nephilim grow huge feeding on a dragon, level the Utvara settlement, and leave for Ravnica City after Niv-Mizzet destroys two of them.
timeline.quote: The Utvara settlement was leveled, and many were killed.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crixizix leads the town's reconstruction.
timeline.quote: Crixizix led the town's reconstruction efforts.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: About 60 years later, Domri Rade performs the Burying in Utvara; the stress ignites his spark and sends him to Alara.
timeline.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him to Alara from inside the sarcophagus he was buried in.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Izzet League, on Zomaj Hauc's orders, sends Kaluzax to drop a prototype mana bomb on the plague-ridden Utvara zone.
timeline.quote: Kaluzax was sent on this mission by his boss, Chief Observer Valuzax

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Gruul warband attacks and badly damages Kaluzax's observosphere.
timeline.quote: managed to badly damage the vessel

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bomb detonates mid-air, with catastrophic and unprecedented results.
timeline.quote: The bomb detonated mid-air

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The explosion tears open the Schism; every soul in Utvara is ripped from its body and the Schism snags Agyrem.
timeline.quote: every soul in Utvara was ripped from their bodies

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Schism mutates the plague into an airborne plague wind; the guilds respond.
timeline.quote: mutating it to become airborne

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crix becomes lost when Gruul attack Teysa Karlov's lokopede, then reaches the Cauldron with help from Vor Golozar, Agrus Kos and Pivlic.
timeline.quote: she was able to reach the Cauldron and deliver her message

citation.text: "Crixizix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Dissension Crix witnesses Niv-Mizzet fight the nephilim and helps Utvara, healing Pivlic.
timeline.quote: She helped the citizens of nephilim-ravaged Utvara

citation.text: "Crixizix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
